notes.TWN: 台灣不在世界銀行（IMF 國際金融統計）的資料中。改用中央銀行公布的年底外匯存底（不含黃金），加上央行持有的黃金約 1,362 萬盎司（約 424 公噸）乘上當年 12 月的平均金價（IMF）估算的市值，跟其他國家「黃金以年底市價計」的口徑一致。2025 年底外匯存底 6,026 億美元、黃金約 588 億美元，合計 6,613 億美元；央行國際投資部位表的「準備資產」把黃金以帳面成本計，是 6,075 億美元。2003 年起

notesEn.TWN: Taiwan is not in the World Bank (IMF International Financial Statistics) data. The central bank's year-end foreign exchange reserves (which exclude gold) are used instead, plus the market value of its roughly 13.62 million troy ounces (about 424 tonnes) of gold at the December average price (IMF), matching the other countries' figures, where gold is valued at year-end market prices. End-2025: foreign exchange reserves US$602.5 billion and gold about US$58.8 billion, US$661.3 billion in total; the reserve assets in the central bank's international investment position carry gold at book value, US$607.5 billion. From 2003
